autoPruneSummary_one: Removed {{count}} item no longer producible by your current settings.
autoPruneSummary_other: Removed {{count}} items no longer producible by your current settings.
ceilModeHint: Shows the physical build: facility counts round up to whole buildings, each paying its full power draw. Off shows fractional, theoretical counts.
binFusionTooltip: Combine formulas that share a building into one card.
calculationError: An error occurred during production plan calculation. Please check your targets and formula overrides.
cycleWarning: The selected formula for {{overriddenItems}} creates a production loop that cannot sustain the required output. Affected items: {{affectedItems}}.
cycleWarningNoAffected: The selected formula for {{overriddenItems}} creates a production loop that cannot sustain the required output.
packerOverrideInfeasible: Formula "{{recipe}}" on facility "{{facility}}" has no valid bin shape. Packer fell back to per-formula bins for this formula.
packerFallback: Multi-formula bin packer fell back to per-formula bins due to an infeasible constraint configuration.
maximizedToWithFit: {{item}} maximized to {{rate}}/min. Other unlocked targets were reduced to fit.
maximizeNoLimit: No limit reached. Nothing in this item's chain is constrained by your configured limits.
maximizeInfeasible: Cannot maximize: the locked targets alone already exceed the configured limits.
fitApplied: Targets scaled down to fit the configured limits.
fitNoop: The plan already fits the configured limits.
fitImpossible: Cannot fit: the locked targets alone exceed the configured limits.
optimizeFailed: Optimization aborted: the solver reported an error.
autoFitHint: When an edit pushes the plan over its limits, other unlocked targets shrink automatically to fit. Locked targets are never adjusted.
metastorageImportsHint: Imports from other regions' Metastorage into this plan. Each source exports one auto-selected item; set a route to Auto, Disabled, or a fixed destination region.
powerSustainHint: Adds Thermal Banks and battery production so the plan generates the power it consumes. Targeted batteries are never burned.
powerSustainUnavailable: Self-sustaining power: no battery can be produced or imported with the current settings, so no power is generated.
powerSustainInsufficient: Not enough resources within your limits to produce batteries for {{watts}} of power. Raise limits or unlock targets.
powerDeficit: Power generation falls short of consumption by {{deficit}} (whole-building rounding).
planLpInfeasible: No valid production plan exists for these targets. The solver could not satisfy every constraint. Check pinned formulas and import routes.
planSolverError: The solver failed unexpectedly and the plan could not be computed. It will recover on the next recalculation. Edit any target to retry.

title: Endfield Calc
metastorageRouteConflict: Metastorage carries one item type per source region. These targets can't all be imported: {{items}}
metastorageBudgetInsufficient: {{item}} from {{source}}: needs {{needed}} TTV per delivery but the budget is {{cap}}. Import not applied. Reduce the target rate or expand local production.
gasEnvUnavailable: Gas environment: {{item}} cannot be supplied, so no Gas Dispersing Unit was planned. Gas consumption is understated.
machinesPerVaporizerHint: How many machines that need a gaseous environment one Gas Dispersing Unit's aura covers (13×13 area, buildings must fit fully inside). The plan adds one always-on unit (6 gas/min) per group.

dictionary.selectPrompt: Select a material to see how it is made and where it is used.
dictionary.directSafe: Direct usage lookup does not recursively traverse recipes.
dictionary.noProducer: No production recipe is registered for this item.
dictionary.usedForHint: Every recipe that consumes this item. This list is non-recursive and cannot loop.
dictionary.downstreamHint: Recursive expansion stops at cycles and has depth/node limits as a second safeguard.
dictionary.usedForVisualHint: Each row shows what this material must be combined with and what it produces.
dictionary.onlyTerminalPackaging: Only terminal packaging uses are hidden. Turn the filter off to show them.
dictionary.usageMapHint: Materials are de-duplicated. Pan and zoom to follow the downstream graph; recipe cards show required co-inputs.
dictionary.directUseHint: Logistics-only filling and dismantling cycles are omitted.
dictionary.destinationHint: Choose a destination to show only the shortest production route from the current material.
dictionary.noUsefulDestination: No registered useful destination is reachable.
